landmarks.description:

Set off the bomber to blow up the obstacles here, then take the elevator to the Crimson Manor.

landmarks.name: Enter the Flesh Lily Fields Here
landmarks.description: From the Valley Sha-Chi Tower 1st Floor Bell, enter the Sha-Chi Tower. On floor 1, take the slide ahead on the right to enter the Flesh Lily Fields area.

landmarks.name: locked one-way gate
landmarks.description:

From the Creek Valley Plains Entrance Bell, pass the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate, then turn left and go all the way to the end. Enter the Sha-Chi Tower Base area through the Sha-Chi Tower Base Entrance and climb all the way to the top level. Unlock the Door Barred from the Other Side on the platform where the Shadow Warden is located.

landmarks.name: Ladder You Can Kick Down

On the platform with the bomber in the Sha-Chi Tower Base area.

landmarks.name: Ladder You Can Kick Down
landmarks.description:
Location:
Climb down two ladders from the top floor of the Sha-Chi Tower to open this shortcut.

landmarks.name: [Early-Game Crutch] Jagged Steel
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute.

Weapon assessment:
One of the stronger weapons in the first area. Its ultimate attack has strong interruption and causes bleeding. For exploration, pairing it with Sanguine Reach is recommended: use Sanguine Reach against shield-bearing enemies and Jagged Steel against the others.

landmarks.name: Sanguine Reach
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Pick it up beside the blacksmith.

Weapon assessment:

An important early-game shield-breaking weapon. Keep it in weapon slot 2 as a backup, paired with Jagged Steel in slot 1.

landmarks.name: Sanguine Twin
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
From Yu'er's location, jump up and follow the stream. The Sanguine Twin weapon is up ahead.

Your first secondary weapon. Once you have emptied an enemy's Sha-Chi, switching to these blades for three consecutive Sha-Chi attacks is a good way to drain their health.

landmarks.name: [Powerful Weapon] Scarlet Wraithblade
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Hua, Deadly Betrothed.

Weapon assessment:

A two-handed weapon that relies heavily on upgraded skills. The lifestealing Outlaw Warblade is available in the second area, and Broadplate Metal is scarce early on, so choose one of the two according to your preference.

landmarks.name: Hunter's Chain Sickle
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat The Hunt.

Weapon assessment:

Essential for exploration, but unremarkable in combat. Saving your limited Dark Source for shield-breaking Phantom Edges is still recommended.

landmarks.name: Feather Bow
landmarks.description: Obtained as a reward after speaking with the Brooding Old Archer after completing the Purge the Sect side quest.

landmarks.name: Dread Axe
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Peng Meng, the Axemaster.

Weapon assessment:

An unremarkable shield-breaking weapon. The wind generated while charging can interrupt some attacks from regular enemies. Iron Gauntlets can serve as a replacement later.

landmarks.name: Shenji's Ring
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Lady's Cave Bell, pass through the cave and out the other side. Open the chest to obtain the Shenji's Ring accessory, and collect the Colorful Pinwheel story item nearby.

Effect:

Sha-Chi cost when blocking attacks -20%.

landmarks.name: Medicine Case
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Complete Apprentice Healer.

Effect:

Flask healing +20%.

landmarks.name: Counterstrike Bracers
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Defeat the Gold-Masked One in Weeping Creek Valley.

Effect:

Damage dealt to enemies +20% for 2 seconds after a perfect block.

landmarks.name: [Must-Have] Reflex Device
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Beside the bell on floor 1 of the Sha-Chi Tower Base area. Obtain it after opening the Sha-Chi furnace inspection port.

Effect:

Perfect defense and perfect dodge timing windows +15%.

P.S.:

This accessory can be upgraded to +2 early on, increasing the timing-window bonus to +25%. It is very powerful, so obtaining it in the first chapter is recommended.

landmarks.name: Ancient Armor Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Beside the Crimson Manor Bell.

Effect:

The higher your health, the greater the damage reduction. At full health, damage reduction is 20%.

landmarks.name: Token of Pursuit
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the chest on the platform below the bell room.

Effect:

Damage dealt to enemies whose guard is broken +7%.

landmarks.name: Stoneguard Bracers
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Only obtainable after killing the Axemaster and speaking with the Terrified Mandate Disciple at the Outpost.

Location:

From the bell, follow the route in image 2, turning left toward the grave. Interact with the grave to obtain it.

Effect:

Damage taken while your guard is not broken -15%.

Note:

Entering Village of Lu causes an incident at the Outpost, and the Terrified Mandate Disciple disappears. Obtain this accessory during this chapter.

landmarks.name: Battle Wraps
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Head forward from the First Meeting with Yu'er Bell, cross the bridge, and defeat the group of enemies to receive the Battle Wraps accessory.

Effect:

Damage dealt to enemies +5%.

landmarks.name: Hunter's Insight
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Leave the Lady's Rift Bell and follow the cliff edge. When you see the chain, jump across and defeat the enemies to receive the Hunter's Insight accessory.

Effect:

Damage and Sha-Chi depletion against enemies that are attacking +7%.

landmarks.name: Pendant of Righteousness
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

After defeating this area's final boss and obtaining the Hunter's Chain Sickle, return behind the spawn point. Grapple to the platform opposite and open the chest.

Effect:

Sha-Chi cost of Sha-Chi combos -15%.

landmarks.name: Vessel Restorative
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Creek Valley Plains Entrance Bell, pass the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate, then turn left and go all the way to the end. Enter the Sha-Chi Tower Base area through the Sha-Chi Tower Base Entrance and climb all the way to the top level. Open the chest behind the Door Barred from the Other Side.

Effect:

Restores 70% health and increases natural Sha-Chi recovery speed by 50% for 5 seconds.

Uses: 2

landmarks.name: Focus Pill
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Break the chains with the Dread Axe and open the chest at the cliff beyond.

Effect:

All Sha-Chi loss -30% for 15 seconds. Gradually restores 30% health over that duration.

Uses: 3

landmarks.description:
How to Obtain:

Southwest of the Weeping Creek Long Pillar, there are rocks inside a cave that can only be blasted open with the Tiger Cannon. Use the Tiger Cannon to blast open the wall by the Long Pillar, then obtain this from the treasure chest behind the wall.

Can be used for Soul Tempering the Bashpole.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description:

From the Long Pillar Overlook Bell, follow the route in image 2 to the river beneath the bridge. Grapple onto the wooden platform and open the chest.

From the Creek Valley Plains Entrance Bell, pass the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate, then turn left and go all the way to the end. Enter the Sha-Chi Tower Base area through the Sha-Chi Tower Base Entrance, then defeat the group of monks that appears in front of the bell.

landmarks.description:

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:

From the Rustblade Pavilion Bell, head north up the steps, then turn right. Pass the pavilion and defeat the group of enemies ahead to receive a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

From the Broken Puppet Valley Bell, go all the way forward and to the left. Defeat the shield-bearing enemy and open the nearby chest for a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment.

If you do not have the Hunter's Chain Sickle, defeat The Hunt first and return afterward.

Use:

Kill the monk beside the merchant to obtain the story item Prayer Beads.

You will meet his teacher, Master Bi Hai, later in Village of Lu. Giving him the Prayer Beads rewards you with an accessory.

landmarks.name: Puppet's Wooden Tongue
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain:

Complete the side story "The Herald's Illusion" and find all 3 dream portals in the game, then obtain this at the entrance to the Red House.

Dream portal locations:
1. Village of Lu — Puppet Testing Grounds: There is a portal at the fork east of the bell. Enter it to receive the purple quest "The Herald's Illusion (Village of Lu)".
2. Mandate Encampment — Training Grounds Depths: Around the bell; the portal opens after the area's boss battle ends.
3. Mountain of Imprisonment: After defeating Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade, use the Flying Guillotine to open the door leading underground. Speak to Inanis at the bottom of the platforming section to complete the quest.

Use:

Opens the main door of the Red House.

landmarks.name: Jagged Steel, The Frenzied Brute
landmarks.description:
The first boss. Beyond the Red Thread Barrier, you will find a group of enemies fighting each other; this boss is among them.

Rewards:

One-handed weapon: Jagged Steel

Tips:

1. This boss is already fighting other enemies. You can wait for them to wear him down before joining the fight.

2. The game's core combat idea is to deplete the enemy's Sha-Chi as quickly as possible, deal as much damage as you can while their guard is broken, and repeat.

Against most bosses, maintain offensive pressure rather than relying on defensive counters while waiting for blue or red flashes. A defensive-counter approach can make fights painfully slow.

3. Switch between your two weapons to keep your own Sha-Chi topped up while steadily depleting the enemy's. When their Sha-Chi reaches zero and their guard breaks, go on the offensive.

landmarks.name: The Gold-Masked One
landmarks.description:
A wild Master Ip appears! He could take on ten of me!
---------------------------------------

Tips:

He is normally invulnerable: ordinary attacks do not reduce his health. You can only create a damage window by depleting his Sha-Chi with perfect blocks and perfect dodges.

Recommended equipment: A two-handed weapon with high guard-breaking power to empty the yellow gauge quickly, plus Jagged Steel to deal extra bleed damage after his guard breaks. The Reflex Device accessory is essential for greater room for error.

Move breakdown:

Red-flash grabs:

1. Sliding slashes + somersault chop: He slides forward while slashing repeatedly, then jumps up for a final red-flash downward chop.

2. Short somersault chop: He jumps straight into an aerial somersault and a red-flash downward chop, with a shorter startup.

3. Triple kick into grab: He jumps and kicks three times, then flashes red and grabs you. This move is not consistent.

4. Instant-movement grab (the hardest): After standing still, he suddenly starts walking forward. Occasionally, he then flashes red and instantly closes in to grab you. This is purely a reaction check.

5. Spinning red-flash kick: A forward sword chop, one full spin, then a red-flash kick.

6. Backhand red-flash thrust: Two sweeping sword strikes, then he turns and thrusts forward backhand with a red flash.

The key response: The instant the red-grab indicator begins, mash dodge to trigger "Ghost Step". The finisher may flash red or blue; this is not fixed. It is better to miss a blue-flash opportunity than to mistime a dodge against a red flash.

Blue-flash attacks (2 types):

1. Sword-energy waves + blue-flash downward chop: He releases sword energy while on the ground, leaps up for several more waves, then finishes with a blue-flash downward chop. This is the easiest move in the fight to perfect-block.

2. Flipping blue-flash downward chop: After jumping and kicking several times, he flips into a downward chop. Judge it by reacting or by watching the chop's arc.

Response: His consecutive aerial sword-energy waves are followed by a blue-flash downward chop 100% of the time. Use this move for perfect blocks as often as possible.

Special mechanics:

Normally invulnerable: Ordinary attacks do not reduce his health. You can only deplete his Sha-Chi during the few seconds after a perfect block or dodge. Three perfect blocks or dodges empty his Sha-Chi; use the opening for a round of damage.

When knocked down: If he pins you to the ground, do not roll or run. Get up slowly in place and use medicine. Rolling or sprinting triggers his attack inputs.

landmarks.name: The Hunt, Hunter of the Order
landmarks.description:
Rewards:

Phantom Edge: Hunter's Chain Sickle

Tips:

1. The Hunt has a second phase. If you die after reaching it, you can return after reviving and resume the fight from phase 2. This is a very forgiving feature.

2. Phase 1:

The Hunt's blue- and red-flash attacks have very long reach, so keep watching the color of his flashes.

3. Phase 2:

Watch for The Hunt's two blue-flash attacks. When he hangs in midair swinging his chain, they always occur in the middle of the combo.

For his other moves, simply hold the block button. After precisely blocking a blue-flash attack, you can teleport beside The Hunt and land a full combo. This reliably triggers Jagged Steel's bleeding effect.

4. If The Hunt disappears, avoid the purple chains falling from the sky. They drop vertically toward you, so run sideways out of their range.

Once all the chains have fallen, The Hunt rushes toward you. Tap block just before he reaches you to leave him wide open for a full combo.

landmarks.name: Hua, Deadly Betrothed
landmarks.description:
From Sha-Chi Tower 1st Floor, take the stairs ahead on the right all the way down. Then climb the stairs on the left to the top, where Hua, Deadly Betrothed is located.

Tips:

Type: A puppet-type enemy. Jagged Steel's bleeding effect does not work on her.

Main difficulty: She can throw three kinds of moves at you at once, making it easy to die from a single sequence of mistakes.

Learn what triggers her three red-flash grabs, prioritize avoiding the red flowers, and save your ultimate attack. Once you do, she is purely an input-reading opponent; even players who struggle with execution can beat her without much trouble.

Move breakdown:

Red-flash grabs:

Hua reads your inputs and selects moves that punish the actions you habitually use:

Input-read grab: If you attack, Hua reads the input and follows with a red-flash grab. Do not overcommit to attacks; leave room to dodge.

White-flower grab: If you tend to dodge, she follows the white flowers with a red-flash grab. Dodge the white flowers sideways and watch for the grab afterward.

Chop-to-grab: If you tend to block, a powerful overhead chop is always followed by a red flash. Note that this is not the black-flash heavy chop. Prepare to dodge when you see this overhead chop.

The key to handling red-flash grabs: The instant the red-grab indicator begins, mash dodge to trigger "Ghost Step" and get in several free hits.

Blue-flash attacks:

These only appear during normal-attack combos.

Response: Hold block and use precise blocks to trade blows while waiting for the blue flash, then follow up after blocking. When your Sha-Chi is nearly empty, switching weapons also lets you squeeze in another hit.

Flower mechanics:

Red flowers:

Whenever you see her flurry in place to summon red flowers, immediately prioritize getting outside the flower circle.

White flowers:

She releases three homing flowers during combos. Block them directly to deal with them; move sideways toward Hua and dodge laterally.

Spider lilies on the floor:

The red flowers Hua creates are more vivid than the red flowers already in the arena. Be careful to distinguish them.

When the white flowers are about to attack, or when all the white flowers disappear, Hua always teleports beside you to attack. Be ready in advance.

landmarks.name: Peng Meng, The Axemaster
landmarks.description:
Rewards:

Dread Axe

Tips:

1. Starting with the Axemaster, bosses gain a new type of attack. Black energy rises from them when they use it, and blocking these attacks instantly empties your Sha-Chi. The rule of thumb is: block blue; dodge red and black.

2. Remember to switch weapons frequently during offense and defense to restore Sha-Chi. If maintaining offensive pressure is difficult, this boss can also be beaten easily with defensive counters and repeated parries of his red- and blue-flash attacks.

landmarks.name: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet
landmarks.description:
Rewards:

Story item: Three-Headed Doll

Tips:

Interact with the Statue of the Lady of the Veil to enter the boss arena. This boss has high stats; exploring here after completing the main story in Village of Lu is recommended.

This is the game's equivalent of the Tree Sentinel: its moves are not complicated, but its stats are very high. Watch out mainly for its black guard-breaking attacks.
